correctness.rationale: A symmetric-difference lemma makes each induced base matching unique. Every prism facet therefore has identical horizontal matchings on both layers, yielding an exact face criterion. The explicit rung/upper-lift involution has zero or one critical faces. The horizontal projection is monotone on any directed face-poset arrow; with fixed projection, horizontal lifts or bottom lifts can only decrease, so the designated pivot cannot reverse along a cycle. This establishes a uniform acyclic matching and the asserted point-or-sphere integral homotopy type. An independent checker verified the entire face poset of all 613 eligible graphs on up to five vertices and seven larger examples, plus the C4 boundary.

value.rationale: This is a natural classification for all forests and odd-cactus graphs, not simply a finite table. The structural cause is uniqueness of perfect matchings in every induced base subgraph; the uniform acyclic matching transfers that structural condition to a complete integral homotopy dichotomy and nonshellability across an infinite family. A four-cycle furnishes a motivated sharp boundary. Covered path and odd-cycle corollaries are explicitly separated from the new general scope.
